notes: Introducing Rapid+ Pro: unlimited profiles, saved proxies, full sync (passwords, history, open tabs), scheduled auto-clear, custom avatars, a built-in ad & tracker blocker, and developer mode. Redesigned toolbar and start page with a new "For you" feed of news, videos and blogs. Added a quick site-info panel and a new look and logo.

desktop.notes: Fixes bookmark sync, which wasn't working, and folds "Sign in to sync" into the same Google sign-in instead of a separate one.
